title: Home Loan - Looking to Refinance with Equity Release
body:
Looking to refinance by current loan. Up Bank with 5.95% interest rate looks good and preferred at Ozbargain at the moment. Haven't seen any refinance deals with lots of positive votes.
I want to refinance with say
X home loan
small Y amount as equity release. So this becomes an investment loan
Anyone know if Up Bank allow to do equity release given they only support loans for primary residence only. Also other recommendation of other banks who offer with competitive rates.
I am with BankWest. Their investment loan was 6.49%. Looks like for investment it should be around 6.15% or 6.19%
